title: WHY did ancient sculptors carve depth that modern 3D software can barely render? #Shorts
description:
WHY did ancient sculptors carve depth that modern 3D software can barely render?

The *Ravananugraha* relief panel in Cave 16 has over 4 feet of sculptural depth. Figures behind Ravana are sculpted fully in the round with negative space completely cleared behind their torsos. Art historians rate it among the most geometrically complex stone sculptures in human history.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
